units.source_text: 在游览车车厢内就失去了游山所应有的快活气氛。

en.t: Inside the sightseeing bus, the cheerful mood that should have belonged to an outing in the hills had already vanished.

units.source_text: 因为柏木和那小姐在不停地争论——

en.t: That was because Kashiwagi and the young lady kept arguing without pause—

units.source_text: 听不清楚他们的争论内容，只见小姐有时像是要强忍住眼泪似地紧咬着嘴唇。

en.t: I could not make out what they were arguing about; I only saw the young lady sometimes bite her lip hard, as if forcing back tears.

units.source_text: 公寓房东的姑娘对这一切漠不关心，只顾低声地哼着流行歌曲。

en.t: The daughter of the lodging-house owner was indifferent to all of this and merely kept humming popular songs under her breath.

units.source_text: 她拍冷子冲着我打开了话匣子：

en.t: Then, quite suddenly, she turned to me and began to talk:
